newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index softens in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index softens in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell 32.5 points or 1.10
percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 0.18 percent.
Nov 1 Oct 25 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index fell 32.50 points in a fairly subdued week of trading.
The speculative resource sector held its ground most of the week before buckling to selling pressure on Friday.
The stark turnaround was reflected in the falls outnumbering gains four to three.
Gains included Morgan's Gold Mines Ltd up seven cents to 33 cents, kaolin hopeful Venture Exploration NL up 5.5 to 41.5 and diamond explorer Diamin Resources NL up 0.6 cents to 5.4 cents.

Falls included Panorama Resources NL six cents to 51 cents, Tribune Resources NL 1.5 cents to 10 cents, Golden Tiger Resources NL 10 cents to 65 cents, Julia Mines NL 2.5 cto 16 cents, Strategic Minerals Corp 1.5 cents to 6.5 cents and Acclaim Exploration NL 1.4 cents to six cents.
